description: This file is a JavaScript script that runs code linting tools (OXC and ESLint), processes their JSON outputs, and uploads metrics and issues to Google Sheets. It includes functions for executing shell commands, handling Google Sheets API authentication, and processing lint results.

methods.name: writeToGoogleSheet
methods.description: Uploads data to a specified Google Sheet range, either appending or updating.

methods.name: runOxlintAndProcess
methods.description: Main function that runs OXC and ESLint, processes their JSON outputs, and uploads metrics and issues to Google Sheets.
